title: file_wrappers: Distinguish LZ4 fast seeks to frames vs blocks
description:
Even with independent blocks we have to reset the compression
context when jumping to the start of the same frame. Distinguish
between fast seek points that are the start of LZ4 frames and
those that are at the start of blocks, similar to what is done
with zlib. This is necessary to make "View as File Format" work.

notes.body: The reason for this is that if an entire LZ4 frame is read, including the EndMark that indicates the end of a frame (and optionally checksum), LZ4 will give an error if another block is read with resetting the compression context (or reading a frame start).
